# Synthetic workiz move-in fixture

Authored synthetic saved API responses, not a real owner export. Field names follow https://developer.workiz.com/v2/. No account or provider acceptance is claimed.

Workiz details: clients, users, items, detailed jobs (notes and attachment descriptors), leads, detailed estimates, detailed invoices with amountDue. API v2 does not expose a recurring-schedule definition; this fixture does not claim that proof.
